---
title: "06 Pathway enrichment (Chapter 3)"
output: html_document
---

Each fitted contrast is tested by preranked gene-set enrichment (fgsea), ranking genes by the limma moderated t-statistic.

The gene-set lib is built from:

- two curated PI3K–mTOR sets defined below;
- Hallmark, 
- KEGG mTOR/insulin/neurotrophin, 
- Reactome mTOR and 
- HPO epilepsy/cortical sets in MSigDB v2024.1;
- a separate HPO epilepsy and cortical-malformation GMT.

For `HP_CORTICAL_DYSPLASIA` and `HP_FOCAL_CORTICAL_DYSPLASIA`, the version in
the separate GMT replaces the MSigDB version. Download links are included in README.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(fgsea))
source(file.path("..", "R", "helpers.R"))
paths <- load_paths()
```

## Parameters

```{r parameters}
collection_patterns <- list(
  hallmark = "^HALLMARK_",
  kegg = "^KEGG_MTOR_SIGNALING|^KEGG_INSULIN_SIGNALING|^KEGG_NEUROTROPHIN",
  reactome = "MTOR",
  hpo = "^HP_.*EPILEPSY|^HP_.*CORTICAL")
prefer_newer_hpo <- c("HP_CORTICAL_DYSPLASIA", "HP_FOCAL_CORTICAL_DYSPLASIA")

fgsea_seed <- 12345L
min_size <- 15L
max_size <- 500L
min_ranked_genes <- 100L
fdr_threshold <- 0.05
```

## Gene sets

```{r gene-sets}

gene_sets <- list(
  PIK3CA_PROXIMAL_CASCADE = c(
    "PIK3CA", "PIK3CB", "PIK3CD", "PIK3CG", "PIK3R1", "PIK3R2", "PIK3R3", "PTEN", "PDPK1",
    "AKT1", "AKT2", "AKT3", "TSC1", "TSC2", "RHEB", "MTOR", "RPTOR", "MLST8", "AKT1S1",
    "RPS6KB1", "RPS6KB2", "EIF4EBP1"),

  NEURON_MTOR_RAPAMYCIN_RESP = c(
    "EEF1A1", "EEF1A2", "EEF2", "EIF4A1", "EIF4B", "EIF4E", "RPS6", "RPS6KB1", "RPS6KB2",
    "RPTOR", "NPM1", "NOP56", "NOP58", "FBL", "DKC1", "ARC", "CAMK2A", "GRIA1", "BDNF",
    "MAP1B", "ULK1", "ATG13", "RB1CC1", "BECN1", "MYC", "CCND1", "CDK4", "LDHA", "PKM",
    "HK2", "SLC2A1", "DDIT4", "SESN1", "SESN2"))

gmt_files <- list.files(paths$msigdb_dir, pattern = "\\.symbols\\.gmt$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f in gmt_files) {
  g <- fgsea::gmtPathways(f)
  keep <- unique(unlist(lapply(collection_patterns, grep, x = names(g), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
  gene_sets <- c(gene_sets, g[setdiff(keep, prefer_newer_hpo)])
}

epi <- fgsea::gmtPathways(paths$epilepsy_gmt)
epi <- lapply(epi, function(x) x[!grepl("^http", x)])
gene_sets <- c(gene_sets, epi[lengths(epi) > 0L])

# Retain the first copy of any duplicate gene set names

dup_names <- unique(names(gene_sets)[duplicated(names(gene_sets))])
keep <- rep(TRUE, length(gene_sets))
for (nm in dup_names) {
  idx <- which(names(gene_sets) == nm)
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    if (!keep[idx[i]] || i == length(idx)) next
    for (j in idx[(i + 1L):length(idx)])
      if (keep[j] && setequal(unique(gene_sets[[idx[i]]]), unique(gene_sets[[j]]))) keep[j] <- FALSE
  }
}

gene_sets <- gene_sets[keep]
length(gene_sets)
```

## fgsea per contrast

```{r fgsea}

de_dir  <- file.path(paths$work_dir, "05_differential_expression")

out_dir <- file.path(paths$work_dir, "06_pathways")

for (f in list.files(de_dir, pattern = "_toptable\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)) {
  cell_type   <- basename(dirname(f))
  contrast_id <- sub("_toptable\\.tsv$", "", basename(f))
  de <- utils::read.delim(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  stat <- setNames(de$t, de$gene_id)
  ranks <- sort(stat[is.finite(stat)], decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(ranks) < min_ranked_genes) next

  set.seed(fgsea_seed)

  fg <- as.data.frame(fgsea::fgsea(pathways = gene_sets, stats = ranks, minSize = min_size,
                                   maxSize = max_size, eps = 0, nproc = 1L))
  fg$cell_type <- cell_type; fg$contrast_id <- contrast_id
  fg$padj_significant <- is.finite(fg$padj) & fg$padj < fdr_threshold

  leading_edge <- data.frame(cell_type = cell_type, contrast_id = contrast_id,
                             pathway_id = fg$pathway, NES = fg$NES, padj = fg$padj,
                             leading_edge_genes = vapply(fg$leadingEdge, paste, "", collapse = ";"),
                             gene_membership_count = lengths(fg$leadingEdge))

  fg$leadingEdge <- vapply(fg$leadingEdge, paste, "", collapse = ";")

  tag <- paste0(cell_type, "__", contrast_id)
  save_tsv(fg, file.path(out_dir, paste0("fgsea_", tag, ".tsv")))
  save_tsv(leading_edge, file.path(out_dir, paste0("leading_edge_", tag, ".tsv")))
}
```

## Check against uploaded results

```{r verify}
dep_dir <- file.path(paths$zenodo_root, "results", "pathways")

for (f in list.files(out_dir, "^fgsea_.*\\.tsv$")) {
  a <- read.delim(file.path(out_dir, f)); b <- read.delim(file.path(dep_dir, f))
  stopifnot(identical(a$pathway, b$pathway),
            isTRUE(all.equal(a$NES, b$NES, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(a$padj, b$padj, tolerance = 1e-8)),
            identical(a$leadingEdge, b$leadingEdge))
}

sessionInfo()
```
